/* These rules appear in both documents. */
@view-transition { navigation: auto; }
.route-object { view-transition-name: route-object; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  @view-transition { navigation: none; }
}

These are ordinary links between separate documents, with their own titles and headings. Cross-document support is independent of the same-document API. Read the MDN reference ↗
